name: ICEreality Connect
summary:
Explore a virtual 3D design with your friends and colleagues from your Meta Oculus device.

Share your thoughts and ideas for your 3D designed space as you and your associates walk through it together in a unique experience that will let you see and hear each other while you explore the file.

Whether one person works as the host or everyone is free to roam as needed, ICEreality Connect can help participants move about the whole space and experience all parts of your 3D design.
